institutional_learning_cycle: Observe -> Research -> Verify -> Model -> Human Gate -> Apply -> Measure -> Correct -> Publish -> Learn -> Re-enter the cycle

governed_connection_principle: Institutional strength is not the sum of its components; it is the quality of the governed connections between them.

human_gate_classes.HG3: legal, financial, academic, credential or privacy sensitive; approved private backend and human preapproval required
human_gate_classes.HG4: constitutional doctrine, new authority or official commitment; machine cannot be final decision maker

mandatory_end_to_end_rules: Every case or workflow preserves a trace identifier across material transitions.
Automation may not expand its own mandate.
HG2-HG4 release transitions require attributable human authorisation.
Mandatory source, evidence or safety gate failure blocks release.
Preparation and institutional release are separate states.
Material corrections are measured and fed back into governed learning.
Knowledge reintegration may not silently alter the Doctrine Kernel.

capability_resilience_pairing.rule: Every new institutional capability must be evaluated together with the dependency, vulnerability, misuse path and authority risk it creates.
release_questions: What can fail or be misused?
Who can pause, override or revoke?
What evidence is required before release?

external_delivery_boundary: No external-customer AI delivery is claimed unless separately evidenced.
